name: Single Cell Atlas of Human Ocular Surface snRNA-seq: Cornea, Limbus, Sclera
description: This atlas is an integrated collection of over 147k cells, derived from single-nuclei RNA-seq data of human ocular surface, including cornea, limbus, and anterior sclera. These cells have been categorized into 10 major cell classes and 26 types.

labelsets.name: author_cell_type
labelsets.description: This atlas is an integrated collection of over 147k cells, derived from single-nuclei RNA-seq data of human ocular surface, including cornea, limbus, and anterior sclera. These cells have been categorized into 10 major cell classes and 26 types. This is the initial cell type label for the atlas annotation. These labels will be examined, refined, and updated during the annotation jamboree.

labels.name: Corneal_Superficial_Epi
labels.rationale: 30.3% K_Epi-Superficial from Sanes dataset; majorclass annotated by PAX6, different from Epi-TDC, low expression of KRT12, high expression of KRT24

labels.name: Epi-PMC
labels.rationale: 95.3% K_Epi-Basal+21.3% K_Epi-TA from Sanes datasets; majorclass annotated by PAX6; from Epi-TAC, Epi-PMC, Epi-TDC/PMC, to Epi-TDC, KRT3 expression increases

labels.name: Corneal Stromal Keratocytes
labels.rationale: 50% FibroX+95.5% K_Fibro+74.3% TM_Fibro from Sanes datasets; majorclass annotated by DCN, celltype annotated by ALDH3A1, MME

labels.name: Epi-TDC
labels.rationale: 63.4% K_Epi-Superficial+90.1% K_Epi-Wing+21.7% Limbal_Epi-Wing from Sanes datasets; majorclass annotated by PAX6; from Epi-TAC, Epi-PMC, Epi-TDC/PMC, to Epi-TDC, KRT3 expression increases

labels.name: Corneal Endothelium_C1
labels.rationale: 60.1% K_Endo from Sanes datasets; majorclass annotated by POU6F2

labels.name: Corneal Endothelium_C2
labels.rationale: 36.2% K_Endo from Sanes datasets; majorclass annotated by POU6F2

labels.name: Epi-TDC/PMC
labels.rationale: only 1 sample from Sanes dataset and only 1 sample from our lab, not sure whether we should keep this cluster; majorclass annotated by PAX6; from Epi-TAC, Epi-PMC, Epi-TDC/PMC, to Epi-TDC, KRT3 expression increases

labels.name: Macrophages/Monocytes
labels.rationale: 25.5% Immune+95.7% Macrophage from Sanes datasets; majorclass annotated by PTPRC, celltype annotated by F13A1, SLC1A1

labels.name: Epi-TAC
labels.rationale: 77.7% K_Epi-TA from Sanes datasets; majorclass annotated by PAX6; from Epi-TAC, Epi-PMC, Epi-TDC/PMC, to Epi-TDC, KRT3 expression increases; high expression of MKI67, RRM2

labels.name: NK/T Cells

labels.name: Limbus_Epi

labels.name: Limbus/Sclera Fibroblasts

labels.name: Schwann_N

labels.name: Lymphatic Endothelium
